notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Cards (8)': Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. The three Effects are the Prepared Defenses Effects, so no single starting Effect is set.
Prince Xizor is listed both as a starting card and under Characters (2 copies in all). Characters posted as '(19)' but the lines add to 18; the list totals 60 as posted.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Coruscant Imperial City' / 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Dark Special Edition sites; 'Death Star Docking Bay 327' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Mobilisation Points' dested Mobilization Points.
Posted 'Dengar in P1' dested Dengar In Punishing One; 'Something Special' dested Something Special Planned For Them; 'SEARCH & Destroy' dested Search And Destroy; 'Vibro Axe' dested Vibro-Ax (Dark).
Posted 'Sense combo' and 'Alter combo' dested the Dark Reflections II combos Sense & Uncertain Is The Future and Alter & Collateral Damage.
Byline 'Chewbacca "COK" Of Kashyyyk' is a Star Wars character name (Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk is a card page), so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle COK with no player page.
